name: manual_588e84
claim: For PT gossip database state resolution, treat git rev-parse --git-common-dir ending in .git as a normal checkout whose state belongs at the checkout root, but treat bare repositories and external GIT_DIR common dirs as their own state anchors.

decisions.notes: PR #256 follow-up showed using common_dir.parent for every Git common dir incorrectly places .state beside bare repositories and external git dirs instead of under the common dir itself.

rationale: PR #256 follow-up showed using common_dir.parent for every Git common dir incorrectly places .state beside bare repositories and external git dirs instead of under the common dir itself.
